name: perl-dbd-mysql
description: The `perl-dbd-mysql` skill provides procedural knowledge for implementing the MySQL driver for the Perl5 Database Interface (DBI).
overview: The `perl-dbd-mysql` skill provides procedural knowledge for implementing the MySQL driver for the Perl5 Database Interface (DBI). This tool acts as the "glue" between Perl scripts and MySQL servers, allowing for transparent database access. Use this skill to establish database connections, execute SQL queries, handle results, and manage database-specific configurations within a Perl environment.
